title: 第9章 须弥圣山血海寻煞第10章 冥河试探真身相见
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
离开了不周山那灵气充沛、道韵天成的环境，帝江一路西行，算是真切体会到了什么叫一贫如洗。
越往西走，周遭的景象便越发荒凉。
大地干裂，植被稀疏，空气中弥漫着一种难以言喻的衰败与死寂之气，灵气更是稀薄得可怜，偶尔还能感受到地底深处传来的、因灵脉断裂而引发的细微悲鸣。
这里与不周山相比，确实是蛮荒与仙境的差别。
“这就是龙汉大劫和道魔之争留下的创伤吗？果然惨烈。”
帝江行走在荒芜的山峦之间，心中感慨。
而其体内那属于盘古正宗的精纯血脉，此刻仿佛受到了某种牵引，开始微微发热，传递出一种本能般的冲动，去修复这些受损的大地脉络，去抚平这片土地的伤痕，让盘古所化的天地重归完整与生机！
一股磅礴的土之法则的厚重气息在他周身隐隐流转，似乎只要他愿意，随时可以引动大地之力，尝试接续那些断裂的灵脉。
帝江的脚步微微一顿，眼神中闪过一丝意动。
作为盘古血脉的继承者，看到盘古身躯所化的天地如此破败，他心中确实涌起一股强烈的责任感和不忍。
“若是耗费些时间和法力，一路修复过去，或许能令这西方大地恢复些许生机！”
这个念头极具诱惑力。
但下一刻，帝江深吸一口气，强行压下了血脉的躁动和那股冲动。
“不行，现在还不是时候。”
帝江摇了摇头，眼神重新变得清明而冷静，修复地脉，尤其是西方如此大面积、伤及根本的损伤，绝非易事，必然耗费巨大，甚至可能动摇我的根基，耽误修行。
帝江很清楚自己此行的首要目的，试验十二都天神煞大阵！
这才是能极大提升他即时战力和未来话语权的关键。
实力，才是在洪荒立足、乃至实现一切抱负的根本。
保护洪荒，也需要有足够的力量作为支撑。
若因小失大，为了局部修复而耽误了自身实力的提升，导致未来更大的劫难无法阻止，那才是因噎废食，辜负了盘古血脉。

况且，等到帝江修为更高，比如达到混元大罗金仙之境，对法则的掌控更深，说不定能找到更高效、更彻底的方法来修复西方，或许能从根源上解决西方的问题。
想通了这一点，帝江不再犹豫，也不再刻意放缓脚步去感受那满目疮痍。
收敛了周身不自觉散发的法则气息，将那份对西方大地的怜悯与责任暂时深藏心底。
“眼下，还是尽快找到足够浓郁的煞气为重。”
放眼望去，西方大地除了荒凉还是荒凉，连个像样的生灵聚集地都罕见，更别提什么值得流连的景致了。
帝江彻底失去了旅游观光的兴致。
“直接去源头看看吧。”
帝江心念一动，周身空间法则全力运转。
这一次，不再是悠闲的漫步，而是真正意义上的空间穿梭！
帝江身形瞬间变得模糊，融入了无处不在的空间维度之中。
一步迈出，便是亿万万里山河被甩在身后。
西方的空间似乎比东部更加脆弱和不稳定，但这对于执掌空间法则的帝江而言，反而让他的穿梭更加顺畅。
仅仅耗费了约莫一元会的时间，在帝江的感知中，前方出现了一座虽然同样残破，却依旧能感受到其昔日宏伟根基的大山，曾经的西方祖脉！
content_en:
Leaving the aura-rich and Taoist environment of Buzhou Mountain, Dijiang traveled all the way westward, and truly experienced what it means to be impoverished.
The further west you go, the more desolate the surrounding scenery becomes.
The earth is dry and cracked, the vegetation is sparse, and the air is filled with an indescribable air of decay and death. The spiritual energy is even pitifully thin. Occasionally, you can feel the subtle screams from deep underground caused by the rupture of spiritual veins.
Compared with Buzhou Mountain, this place is indeed the difference between wilderness and fairyland.
"Is this the trauma left behind by the Long Han Catastrophe and the Dao Demon War? It is indeed tragic."
Di Jiang walked among the desolate mountains and sighed in his heart.
The pure bloodline belonging to Pangu's authentic sect in his body seemed to be attracted by something at this moment, and began to heat up slightly, conveying an instinctive impulse to repair these damaged earth veins, to heal the scars of this land, and to restore the integrity and vitality of the world transformed by Pangu!
A heavy aura of majestic earth law circulated faintly around him, and it seemed that as long as he was willing, he could activate the power of the earth at any time to try to connect those broken spiritual veins.
Di Jiang's footsteps paused slightly, and a trace of emotion flashed in his eyes.
As the successor of Pangu's bloodline, seeing the world transformed by Pangu's body in such ruins, he felt a strong sense of responsibility and intolerance in his heart.
"If we spend some time and mana to repair it all the way, we may be able to restore some vitality to this western land!"
The thought was extremely tempting.
But the next moment, Di Jiang took a deep breath and suppressed the restlessness of his blood and the impulse.
"No, now is not the time."
Di Jiang shook his head, and his eyes became clear and calm again. Repairing the earth's veins, especially such a large area and fundamental damage in the West, is not an easy task. It will definitely cost a lot, and may even shake my foundation and delay my practice.
Di Jiang was very clear about the primary purpose of his trip, which was to test the Twelve Heavenly Gods Formation!
This is the key to greatly improving his immediate combat power and future voice.
Strength is the foundation for establishing a foothold in the ancient times and even realizing all ambitions.
Protecting the prehistoric world also requires sufficient strength as support.
If the improvement of one's own strength is delayed for the sake of partial repair due to small losses, and a greater disaster cannot be prevented in the future, then it is a waste of food due to choking and a failure of the Pangu bloodline.
Moreover, when Di Jiang reaches a higher level of cultivation, such as reaching the Hunyuan Daluo Golden Immortal realm, and has a deeper control over the laws, he may be able to find a more efficient and thorough way to repair the West, and may be able to solve the West's problems from the root.
After thinking about this, Di Jiang no longer hesitated, nor did he deliberately slow down to feel the devastation.
He restrained the aura of law that unconsciously emanated from his body, and temporarily hid his compassion and responsibility for the Western land deep in his heart.
"Right now, the most important thing is to find a strong enough evil spirit as soon as possible."
Looking around, the western land is desolate and desolate. It is rare to even have a decent gathering place for living beings, let alone any scenery worth lingering on.
Dijiang completely lost his interest in tourism.
“Let’s go straight to the source.”
With a thought in Di Jiang's mind, the laws of space around him were operating at full strength.
This time, it is no longer a leisurely stroll, but a real space shuttle!
Di Jiang's figure instantly became blurred and merged into the ubiquitous spatial dimension.
With one step forward, hundreds of millions of miles of mountains and rivers are left behind.
The space in the west seems to be more fragile and unstable than in the east, but for Di Jiang, who is in charge of the laws of space, this actually makes his shuttle smoother.
It only took about the time of Yiyuanhui. In Dijiang's perception, a mountain appeared in front of him. Although it was also dilapidated, one could still feel its grand foundation in the past. It was the ancestral line of the West!
